notes:
# BondoMod 0.2.2

- Fixes the Add Plugin, sign-in and account dialogs being clipped by the Clean UI sidebar.
- Removes the Show onboarding again button.
- Keeps the green and black Clean UI design with a static background.
- This release resets local accounts, settings, installed plugins and BondoMod clip files once. Accounts on the server are preserved; sign in again after onboarding and reinstall the plugins you want.
- Packages the rebuilt bridge tested with Dev Boost remaining equipped after a goal.
- Hardens production update verification against environment overrides and reduces bridge log disk work.
